subject: A copy of my reply, from the flamed, Paradise forum, lol.
author: SUFFUR
body:
I did, and i don't want people to agree, it just seems a lot of crying over some outdated milk, and creating your own game and testing it to the nutz still does not make a great game. But people seem to argue over what they want?  If someone wants something that bad, you have to do it yourself, right? 

Forums are open to all, i put in my 1/2 pence, so have you, Das Boot. But Criterion said, no speedo, no boost start (still awaiting the thread), and that was weeks ago, when are we going to get complaints about takedown handling, drifting, e-braking and other stuff that people don't focus on.

I think, someone could make a lot of money, making stickers of different types speedos, so people who do miss them, can stick them on their TV's. But most people seem to be wearing a pair on their heads, blinding themselves, to what Criterion are trying to create. Due to the poor takedown physics, and the bug for boosting, Revenge was and is used as a lap time tracker and rank building, a good game in the series, but its not true way of Burnout, which was to drive like crazy, and survive. With traffic checking it just becomes to easy (the reason it was put in was to cause people to crash and get takedowns off, for more boost, not allowed to do that in a racing room, oh, and to boost jump off), unlike Burnout 3, which mostly, was a test of skill and survival, and luck. Not saying racers on Revenge have no skill, you racers have taken it to another level, but that was not the real focus of Burnout games. Hence Criterion changed the formula, and they did say you were not going to like it, and you lunch time forumers or after work before you jump on a game, of Revenge, have risen to complain, i'm just being the devils advocate, looking at it from the other side.

If you go back on the old forum posts, most people have a bad word to say about Revenge, but we still play it, it's good to socialize, and that is what Burnout has, a great social network, one of the reasons burnoutaholics was created, for racers, crasher and ragers to get together and have fun. I just don't find some of the Xbox forum stuff very fun or funny (the start of this post was, lol). But maybe thats how you racers like to socialize, by ripping the pizz and moderating each other, fair do's, i just thought, and now know i'm wrong, you would like a new game to play, since Revenge is getting old, like Halo 3 (i'm so going to die for that, someone is going to knock on my door with a bottle of candy floss and glass me, the poor man's needler, lol).

On Paradise, a new focus (not the only one mind) is stunt mode for the points make prizes, and trying to rack up the points with 7 others in the world, is going to be fun and a swearing fest, we will still have racing too, and there is a leader board (pod cast 10), so you lappers for times, after building a suitable track will be able to keep score too, you just can't see how fast you were going to do did it, but with calculus, time and distance, will give you figures to be able to work out your average speed, which will occupy some of your forum time, lol...

Keep on burning, and your wheels turning, forum fighters unite, lol. 

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
